verdict.rationale: Numeral is a tax-compliance SaaS/API that ships its own MCP server so other agents can call ITS tools (docs-7, docs-30) — this is the server role, not a client that plugs in and consumes external MCP servers' tools. Numeral is not an agent/orchestration product, so the 'plug MCP servers in to use their tools' axis is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
